agent_user.name: agent_user
agent_user.note: agent, uid 1001; not checked: file capabilities (no getcap)

clean_verifier_env.name: clean_verifier_env
clean_verifier_env.note: no loader variables, PYTHONSAFEPATH=1, PATH of root-owned folders only

hidden_verifier.name: hidden_verifier
hidden_verifier.note: the verifier and oracle are uploaded only when needed

ld_so_preload.name: ld_so_preload
ld_so_preload.note: absent before and after the agent's turn

locked_system_dirs.name: locked_system_dirs
locked_system_dirs.note: system folders were already writable by root alone

locked_system_path.name: locked_system_path
locked_system_path.note: the folders on PATH are root's alone

memory_limit.name: memory_limit
memory_limit.note: 1024 MB (cgroup v2 memory.max), the daytona backend's own; the task sets none

oom_order.name: oom_order
oom_order.note: agent processes start at oom_score_adj 1000, the runner and the verifier at 0, so the kernel stops the agent's first

process_limit.name: process_limit
process_limit.note: the daytona backend cannot cap the number of processes (BenchFlow asks for 4096)

root_service.name: root_service
root_service.note: the uid firewall refuses the agent user's connections to the sandbox daemon's ports (2280, 22220, 22222, 33333) on every local address, and nothing else; the daemon listens on 2280, 22220, 22222, 33333; proof: root reached 127.0.0.1:2280, 172.20.0.45:2280, [::1]:2280, 127.0.0.1:22220, 172.20.0.45:22220, [::1]:22220, 127.0.0.1:22222, 172.20.0.45:22222, [::1]:22222, 127.0.0.1:33333, 172.20.0.45:33333, [::1]:33333 and the agent user was refused at each

state_custody.name: state_custody
state_custody.note: BenchFlow's state folder was root's alone at the handoff
